name: Sōsa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sōsa city emblem in blue, green and orange: a blue stylised swirl with a green leaf and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Sōsa, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 May 2006.

features.role: Sōsa city emblem — a blue stylised swirl with a green leaf and an orange disc
